description: The two narrow model questions of a multi-round case (scripts/case_questions.py). Each is fixed here, never written in code, and neither is a free-form call over the whole case. No result of either has been measured on a model.
agent_note: The registered agent that answers both questions; its model is the backend profile's (under the local profile local_auditor, the shipped auditor model), the registry being the one owner of model choice. PRACTICE_AUDITOR, decision D-295: a shipped local agent that already runs in a B3 review. Its writing of wording is not measured. Null means nothing is asked.

movement.form_note: decision: read from the model's own probabilities with no text (D-S41, local backends only). reply: read from generated text. Which form is a recorded decision, as for passage pairs.
movement.generated_suffix: Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": "toward"}, with answer one of toward, away, neither, cannot be settled.
movement.record_value_note: multi_round.MOVEMENTS is held exact by multi_round_checks, so an answer takes the nearest value of that vocabulary and the literal answer stays beside it in movement_answer. `cannot be settled` has no value here on purpose: the record stays unknown.

suggestion.max_prompt_chars_note: A question over this size is not asked: the free-form case call ran to its output cap on a 15,795-token prompt (INC-023). Conventional limit, no evidence for this exact figure.
suggestion.max_new_tokens_note: The output cap of one suggestion: 900 characters of wording, 400 of reason, and the citations. Conventional limit, no evidence for this exact figure.
